scope: All 30 independently proven base-MP player bodies exported as geometry plus exact 102-bone skin/skeleton at all four serialized LODs
proofBoundary: Body membership, fixed source starts, source hashes, aggregate geometry counts, and skeleton counts remain inherited only from the retained direct-retail 30-body corpus and already-closed native XModel identity census.
Every LOD is decoded from the exact retail faction FastFile payload and exported with exact normalized topology, UV0, normals, JOINTS_0, WEIGHTS_0, hierarchy, and inverse bind matrices.

T6-to-glTF triangle winding is applied by exact per-triangle [i0,i1,i2] -> [i0,i2,i1] transformation. Vertex-normal statistics are an independent corruption sanity check, not the authority for engine front-face convention.
The T6 packed color field is deliberately not promoted to glTF COLOR_0 and its historical accessor/buffer bytes are physically removed from the authoritative GLBs.
These GLBs make no portable Material, TechniqueSet, shader, image, texture, or animation fidelity claim. Those layers remain independently gated.
The four SEAL6 SMG GLBs reproduced byte-for-byte on a second independent export pass in the same pinned retail environment.
